info.title: Nomix Business Knowledge Gateway Agent Contract
info.description: Canonical contract between the Nomix Harness plugin and any business system implementing a Knowledge Gateway. Gateway endpoints and credentials are deployment configuration, not customer-specific constants. It exposes business knowledge resources only; RAGFlow provider details are intentionally absent.

optimisticLock.document: Detail lockVersion and summary version are the same nonnegative lock counter; pass unchanged as expectedVersion. Not versionNo/versionNumber.

x-nomix-business-rules.pagination: page/pageSize echo the request. totalItems counts visible matching resources; totalPages=ceil(totalItems/pageSize); hasNext=page<totalPages. Empty results use totalPages=0; pages beyond totalPages return empty items. Items cannot exceed pageSize or the remaining total.
